title: Japanese Foundations
summary: An alphabet-first beginner Japanese path for reading, recalling, typing, and writing hiragana and katakana before starter kanji.
audience: English-speaking beginners learning Japanese on mobile, tablet, and web.

units.title: Writing Systems
units.summary: See how hiragana, katakana, and kanji work together, and learn the assisted-to-free handwriting loop.

units.title: Read And Write Hiragana
units.summary: Learn the complete 46-character hiragana map in small row groups, then retrieve the sounds from memory.

units.title: Hiragana Sound Tools
units.summary: Decode dakuten, handakuten, small kana, doubled consonants, contracted sounds, and long vowels.

units.title: Read And Write Katakana
units.summary: Reuse the hiragana sound map to learn all 46 basic katakana, key look-alikes, long vowels, and loanwords.

units.title: Romaji And Kana Input
units.summary: Separate Japanese spelling, pronunciation, learner romaji, and the keys an IME needs.

units.title: Starter Kanji
units.summary: Practice beginner kanji for numbers, nature, people, size, position, books, mountains, and rivers.
